taskSpec.problemStatement: The organization needs a centralized Human Resource Management System to streamline employee information, attendance tracking, leave management, payroll processing, performance evaluation, and recruitment processes. Currently, these functions are handled through disparate systems or manual methods, leading to inefficiencies, data inconsistency, and increased administrative overhead.
taskSpec.projectDescription: A web-based HR Management System built with HTML that provides comprehensive functionality for managing employee information, attendance records, leave applications, payroll calculations, performance reviews, and recruitment processes. The system will be implemented as a single-page application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without external dependencies.
taskSpec.projectGoal: To develop a functional, self-contained HRMS web application that demonstrates core HR management capabilities in a single HTML file with basic CRUD operations for all modules while maintaining data persistence through browser storage mechanisms.

excluded: User authentication and role-based access control

constraints: Data persistence limited to browser localStorage

Performance degradation with large datasets
Security concerns with client-side data storage
Scalability limitations for enterprise-level usage
